Data conversion is incredibly important to us. This is why we are going to extract as much as we are able to from your current DMS. Once it is out of your current system, we will securely store it in a database in the Tekion Cloud. For a few reasons, our best practice is to make 7 years of historical information available in the ARC user interface. The remainder of the historical data will be securely stored in our our vault. If you ever need access to this information, you can submit a simple request through our technical support team requesting what you need and for how long. Within 36 hours it will be made available to you. If 7 years isn't going to cut it for OEM, government or other regulations, let us know below. Thanks!

fields.title: Do you want to change your existing chart of accounts?
Notes about the chart of account changes you would like to make:

Please create a mapping document in Excel for any chart of account changes you would like to see made in the conversion. Keep in mind that you can manage the change at any time by creating new G/L accounts and begin using those. For example, if you want to break out an expense account to be department specific, you can do that directly in ARC at go live. If you would like to overhaul your chart (example: converting from a Subaru chart to a Toyota chart), the completed mapping needs to be provided to our conversion team no later than 45 days prior to go live. To create a mapping document, use the format provided by your Implementation Manager. Be sure not to input any circular mapping, for example: 1 to 2, 2 to 3, 3 to 1.
